title: Highlight of the Trip (ETS Official Lesson 1)
promptQuestion: What was the highlight of your trip?
explanation: Oración correcta: 'The tour guides who showed us around the old city were fantastic.' El sujeto es 'tour guides' (plural), por lo que concuerda con 'were'. 'was' es el distractor sobrante.

title: Lab Report Submission (TOEFL Resources Item 1)
promptQuestion: Did Maria submit the lab report?
explanation: Oración correcta: 'No, she has not finished writing it.' La estructura de present perfect 'has not finished' requiere gerundio 'writing it' tras el verbo finish. 'written' es el distractor sobrante.

title: Service Hours (TOEFL Resources Item 2)
promptQuestion: Can we go to the advising center right now?
explanation: Oración correcta: 'It does not open until noon.' Tras el auxiliar 'does not' debe usarse el verbo base 'open', no la forma conjugada 'opens'.

title: Chemistry Study in Library (TOEFL Resources Item 3)
promptQuestion: We'll get together in the library to study for the chemistry exam.
explanation: Oración correcta: 'Should we bring our textbooks there?' Pregunta interrogativa con modal: 'Should' + sujeto 'we' + infinitivo base 'bring'.

title: Postponed Quiz (TOEFL Resources Item 4)
promptQuestion: Professor Jenkins said the quiz is postponed.
explanation: Oración correcta: 'Will she announce the new date soon?' Pregunta futura con auxiliar 'Will' + sujeto 'she' + infinitivo base 'announce'.

title: Chemistry Building Location (TOEFL Resources Item 5)
promptQuestion: It looks like you need help getting somewhere.
explanation: Oración correcta: 'Where can I find the chemistry building?' Pregunta interrogativa con 'Where can I' seguida del infinitivo 'find'.

title: Tutoring Center Schedule (TOEFL Resources Item 6)
promptQuestion: If you need extra help, the tutoring center has a few openings this week.
explanation: Oración correcta: 'When should I schedule an appointment?' Orden interrogativo modal: 'When should I' + verbo base 'schedule'.

title: Project Deadline Notice (TOEFL Resources Item 7)
promptQuestion: I missed the announcement about the final project's new deadline.
explanation: Oración correcta: 'Don't worry, I know when it is due.' Cláusula interrogativa indirecta con orden sujeto-verbo 'when it is due'.

title: Library Databases (TOEFL Resources Item 8)
promptQuestion: I need to find peer-reviewed journals for our research project.
explanation: Oración correcta: 'Do you know where the databases are?' El sustantivo plural 'databases' concuerda con 'are'. 'is' es el distractor de número.

title: Missing Class Notebook (TOEFL Resources Item 9)
promptQuestion: Why didn't you review your notes before taking the test?
explanation: Oración correcta: 'The notebook that I used in class went missing yesterday.' Oración compleja con cláusula relativa 'that I used in class' y verbo principal en pasado 'went missing'.

title: Research Award Winner (TOEFL Resources Item 10)
promptQuestion: Which student ended up winning the research award?
explanation: Oración correcta: 'The student who presented first won it.' Cláusula de relativo que define al sujeto: 'The student who presented first won it'.

title: Experiment Samples Condition
promptQuestion: Why did the experiment fail to yield expected results?
explanation: Oración correcta: 'The samples which were stored improperly spoiled overnight.' El sujeto plural 'samples' rige 'were stored'. 'was' es el distractor.
